turns.prompt: Help me create a youtube thumbnail for this video. I want a png. 1280x720 pixels. In the thumb, I want the text "Você tem consciência?" In the background, use some of the high quality scenes of the actual video, like the masks from ~167s or the white being around the table at around 112s, or create something new and impressive. Work hard to create the most impressive thumbnail options you can... give me 3 options. And by impressive I also mean effective. That attracts clicks.

Use my channel's thumbnail type on all three: Archivo at its narrowest width and heaviest weight (public/fonts/Archivo-w620-900.ttf), all caps, cream #F6F1EB with at most one word in orange #FA5B20, and a soft dark glow. On option 2, make the words bigger. Keep everything else.
